  "textEditContent": "# System Components Architecture - DriftBoard\n\n## Frontend Architecture\n\n### Component Hierarchy\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nApp (Authentication Provider)\n├── AuthGuard\n│   ├── AppLayout (Header, Sidebar, Main)\n│   │   ├── BoardsList (Dashboard)\n│   │   ├── BoardView\n│   │   │   ├── BoardHeader\n│   │   │   ├── ListContainer\n│   │   │   │   ├── List\n│   │   │   │   │   ├── ListHeader\n│   │   │   │   │   ├── CardList\n│   │   │   │   │   │   ├── Card\n│   │   │   │   │   │   │   ├── CardContent\n│   │   │   │   │   │   │   ├── CardLabels\n│   │   │   │   │   │   │   └── CardActions\n│   │   │   │   │   │   └── AddCardButton\n│   │   │   │   │   └── ListActions\n│   │   │   │   └── AddListButton\n│   │   │   └── BoardSettings\n│   │   └── Settings\n│   └── Modals (Card Edit, Board Settings, etc.)\n└── Login/Register Components\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### State Management Architecture\n\n#### Redux Store Structure\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface RootState {\n  auth: AuthState;\n  boards: BoardsState;\n  ui: UIState;\n  api: ApiState; // RTK Query\n}\n\ninterface BoardsState {\n  currentBoard: Board | null;\n  boards: Board[];\n  lists: Record&lt;string, List&gt;;\n  cards: Record&lt;string, Card&gt;;\n  dragState: DragState;\n}\n\ninterface UIState {\n  modals: {\n    cardEdit: { open: boolean; cardId: string | null };\n    boardSettings: { open: boolean; boardId: string | null };\n  };\n  sidebar: { collapsed: boolean };\n  theme: 'light' | 'dark' | 'system';\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### RTK Query API Slices\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// boardsApi.ts\nexport const boardsApi = createApi({\n  reducerPath: 'boardsApi',\n  baseQuery: fetchBaseQuery({\n    baseUrl: '/api/v1/boards',\n    prepareHeaders: (headers, { getState }) =&gt; {\n      // Add auth token\n    },\n  }),\n  tagTypes: ['Board', 'List', 'Card'],\n  endpoints: (builder) =&gt; ({\n    getBoards: builder.query&lt;Board[], void&gt;(),\n    createBoard: builder.mutation&lt;Board, CreateBoardRequest&gt;(),\n    updateBoard: builder.mutation&lt;Board, UpdateBoardRequest&gt;(),\n    deleteBoard: builder.mutation&lt;void, string&gt;(),\n    // Lists and cards endpoints...\n  }),\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Frontend Component Design Patterns\n\n1. **Container/Presentation Pattern**\n   - Container components handle data fetching and state\n   - Presentation components focus on rendering and user interaction\n\n2. **Custom Hooks for Logic**\n   - &#96;useAuth()&#96; - Authentication state and methods\n   - &#96;useDragAndDrop()&#96; - Drag and drop logic\n   - &#96;useLocalStorage()&#96; - Local storage persistence\n   - &#96;useKeyboardShortcuts()&#96; - Keyboard navigation\n\n3. **Error Boundaries**\n   - Component-level error handling\n   - Fallback UI for failed renders\n   - Error reporting to logging system\n\n## Backend Architecture\n\n### API Structure\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n/api/v1/\n├── auth/\n│   ├── POST /verify-token\n│   └── POST /refresh-token\n├── boards/\n│   ├── GET    /                 # List all boards\n│   ├── POST   /                 # Create board\n│   ├── GET    /:id              # Get specific board\n│   ├── PUT    /:id              # Update board\n│   ├── DELETE /:id              # Delete board\n│   └── GET    /:id/export       # Export board data\n├── lists/\n│   ├── POST   /                 # Create list\n│   ├── PUT    /:id              # Update list\n│   ├── DELETE /:id              # Delete list\n│   └── PUT    /:id/position     # Reorder list\n└── cards/\n    ├── POST   /                 # Create card\n    ├── GET    /:id              # Get card details\n    ├── PUT    /:id              # Update card\n    ├── DELETE /:id              # Delete card\n    ├── PUT    /:id/position     # Move card\n    └── POST   /:id/comments     # Add comment\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Backend Service Architecture\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Service Layer\ninterface BoardService {\n  findAll(userId: string): Promise&lt;Board[]&gt;;\n  findById(id: string, userId: string): Promise&lt;Board&gt;;\n  create(data: CreateBoardData, userId: string): Promise&lt;Board&gt;;\n  update(id: string, data: UpdateBoardData, userId: string): Promise&lt;Board&gt;;\n  delete(id: string, userId: string): Promise&lt;void&gt;;\n}\n\n// Repository Layer\ninterface BoardRepository {\n  findByUserId(userId: string): Promise&lt;Board[]&gt;;\n  findById(id: string): Promise&lt;Board | null&gt;;\n  create(board: Board): Promise&lt;Board&gt;;\n  update(id: string, changes: Partial&lt;Board&gt;): Promise&lt;Board&gt;;\n  delete(id: string): Promise&lt;void&gt;;\n}\n\n// Controller Layer\nclass BoardController {\n  constructor(\n    private boardService: BoardService,\n    private authService: AuthService\n  ) {}\n\n  async getBoards(req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) {\n    const boards = await this.boardService.findAll(req.user.id);\n    res.json(boards);\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Middleware Stack\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Express middleware chain\napp.use(helmet()); // Security headers\napp.use(cors(corsOptions)); // CORS configuration\napp.use(express.json({ limit: '10mb' })); // Body parsing\napp.use(requestLogger); // Request logging\napp.use('/api', rateLimiter); // Rate limiting\napp.use('/api', authMiddleware); // Authentication\napp.use('/api/v1', apiRouter); // API routes\napp.use(errorHandler); // Global error handling\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Database Design and Data Flow\n\n### Database Schema (SQLite + Prisma)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;prisma\nmodel User {\n  id        String   @id @default(uuid())\n  firebaseId String  @unique\n  email     String   @unique\n  name      String?\n  createdAt DateTime @default(now())\n  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt\n  \n  boards    Board[]\n  \n  @@map(\"users\")\n}\n\nmodel Board {\n  id          String    @id @default(uuid())\n  name        String\n  description String?\n  color       String?\n  archived    Boolean   @default(false)\n  position    Int       @default(0)\n  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())\n  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt\n  \n  userId      String\n  user        User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  lists       List[]\n  \n  @@map(\"boards\")\n}\n\nmodel List {\n  id        String   @id @default(uuid())\n  name      String\n  position  Int      @default(0)\n  createdAt DateTime @default(now())\n  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt\n  \n  boardId   String\n  board     Board    @relation(fields: [boardId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  cards     Card[]\n  \n  @@map(\"lists\")\n}\n\nmodel Card {\n  id          String    @id @default(uuid())\n  title       String\n  description String?\n  position    Int       @default(0)\n  dueDate     DateTime?\n  completed   Boolean   @default(false)\n  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())\n  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt\n  \n  listId      String\n  list        List      @relation(fields: [listId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  labels      Label[]\n  comments    Comment[]\n  activities  Activity[]\n  \n  @@map(\"cards\")\n}\n\nmodel Label {\n  id       String @id @default(uuid())\n  name     String\n  color    String\n  \n  cardId   String\n  card     Card   @relation(fields: [cardId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  \n  @@map(\"labels\")\n}\n\nmodel Comment {\n  id        String   @id @default(uuid())\n  content   String\n  createdAt DateTime @default(now())\n  \n  cardId    String\n  card      Card     @relation(fields: [cardId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  \n  @@map(\"comments\")\n}\n\nmodel Activity {\n  id        String   @id @default(uuid())\n  type      String   // 'created', 'moved', 'updated', 'commented'\n  data      String   // JSON data about the activity\n  createdAt DateTime @default(now())\n  \n  cardId    String\n  card      Card     @relation(fields: [cardId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  \n  @@map(\"activities\")\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Data Flow Patterns\n\n#### Create Card Flow\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n1. User clicks \"Add Card\" in React\n2. Redux action dispatched\n3. RTK Query mutation triggered\n4. API call to POST /api/v1/cards\n5. Express middleware validates auth\n6. Controller validates input\n7. Service layer processes business logic\n8. Repository creates card in SQLite\n9. Activity log entry created\n10. Response sent back to frontend\n11. RTK Query updates cache\n12. UI re-renders with new card\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Drag and Drop Flow\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n1. User drags card to new position\n2. Optimistic update in Redux state\n3. Background API call to PUT /api/v1/cards/:id/position\n4. Server calculates new positions for affected cards\n5. Database transaction updates multiple cards\n6. If API call fails, revert optimistic update\n7. If successful, sync final positions\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## External Service Integrations\n\n### Firebase Authentication Integration\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Firebase configuration\nconst firebaseConfig = {\n  apiKey: process.env.VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY,\n  authDomain: process.env.VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN,\n  projectId: process.env.VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID,\n};\n\n// Auth service\nclass AuthService {\n  async signInWithGoogle() {\n    const provider = new GoogleAuthProvider();\n    const result = await signInWithPopup(auth, provider);\n    return this.processAuthResult(result);\n  }\n\n  async verifyToken(token: string) {\n    // Backend verification with Firebase Admin SDK\n    const decodedToken = await admin.auth().verifyIdToken(token);\n    return decodedToken;\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Future Integration Points\n- **Export Services**: JSON, CSV, PDF export\n- **Import Services**: Trello, Google Tasks import\n- **Backup Services**: Cloud storage backup (future)\n- **Notification Services**: Email/push notifications (future)\n\n## Caching Strategy\n\n### Frontend Caching\n- **RTK Query**: Automatic API response caching with configurable TTL\n- **Browser Storage**: Redux state persistence for offline functionality\n- **Image Caching**: Browser native caching for avatars and assets\n\n### Backend Caching\n- **In-Memory Cache**: Redis container for session data (future)\n- **Database Query Optimization**: Prisma query optimization and connection pooling\n- **Static Asset Caching**: Nginx caching for static files\n\n### Cache Invalidation Strategy\n- **Tag-based invalidation**: RTK Query tags for granular cache updates\n- **Optimistic updates**: Immediate UI updates with background sync\n- **Real-time sync**: WebSocket connection for multi-device sync (future)\n",

  "textEditContent": "# Scalability &amp; Performance Architecture - DriftBoard\n\n## Performance Considerations\n\nWhile scalability is not an immediate concern for this single-user application, the architecture is designed with future growth in mind. This document outlines current performance optimizations and scalability pathways.\n\n## Current Performance Optimizations\n\n### Frontend Performance\n\n#### React Optimizations\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Component memoization for expensive renders\nconst CardComponent = React.memo(({ card, onUpdate }) =&gt; {\n  return &lt;Card card={card} onUpdate={onUpdate} /&gt;;\n});\n\n// Virtualized lists for large boards\nimport { FixedSizeList as List } from 'react-window';\n\nconst VirtualizedCardList = ({ cards, height }) =&gt; (\n  &lt;List\n    height={height}\n    itemCount={cards.length}\n    itemSize={80}\n    itemData={cards}\n  &gt;\n    {CardRow}\n  &lt;/List&gt;\n);\n\n// Lazy loading for large components\nconst BoardSettings = lazy(() =&gt; import('./BoardSettings'));\nconst CardEditModal = lazy(() =&gt; import('./CardEditModal'));\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Bundle Optimization\n- **Code Splitting**: Route-based and component-based splitting\n- **Tree Shaking**: Unused code elimination via Vite\n- **Asset Optimization**: Image compression and modern formats (WebP)\n- **Bundle Analysis**: Regular bundle size monitoring\n\n#### State Management Performance\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Normalized state structure for O(1) lookups\ninterface BoardsState {\n  boards: { [id: string]: Board };\n  lists: { [id: string]: List };\n  cards: { [id: string]: Card };\n  boardListIds: string[];\n  listCardIds: { [listId: string]: string[] };\n}\n\n// Memoized selectors\nconst selectBoardCards = createSelector(\n  [selectCards, selectCurrentBoardLists],\n  (cards, lists) =&gt; {\n    return lists.flatMap(list =&gt; \n      list.cardIds.map(cardId =&gt; cards[cardId])\n    );\n  }\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Backend Performance\n\n#### Database Optimization\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Optimized indexes for common queries\nCREATE INDEX idx_boards_user_id ON boards(user_id);\nCREATE INDEX idx_lists_board_id ON lists(board_id);\nCREATE INDEX idx_cards_list_id ON cards(list_id);\nCREATE INDEX idx_cards_due_date ON cards(due_date) WHERE due_date IS NOT NULL;\nCREATE INDEX idx_activities_card_id_created_at ON activities(card_id, created_at);\n\n-- Composite indexes for complex queries\nCREATE INDEX idx_cards_list_position ON cards(list_id, position);\nCREATE INDEX idx_boards_user_archived ON boards(user_id, archived);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### API Performance\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Efficient data loading with Prisma\nconst getBoardWithDetails = async (boardId: string, userId: string) =&gt; {\n  return prisma.board.findFirst({\n    where: { id: boardId, userId },\n    include: {\n      lists: {\n        orderBy: { position: 'asc' },\n        include: {\n          cards: {\n            orderBy: { position: 'asc' },\n            include: {\n              labels: true,\n              _count: {\n                select: { comments: true, activities: true }\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  });\n};\n\n// Pagination for large datasets\nconst getCardActivities = async (cardId: string, page = 1, limit = 20) =&gt; {\n  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;\n  return prisma.activity.findMany({\n    where: { cardId },\n    orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    skip,\n    take: limit\n  });\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Response Optimization\n- **Compression**: Gzip/Brotli compression via Nginx\n- **Caching Headers**: Appropriate cache-control headers\n- **Response Size**: Field selection and pagination\n- **Connection Pooling**: Prisma connection optimization\n\n## Scalability Pathways\n\n### Phase 1: Enhanced Single User (Current)\n**Target**: 1 user, 50+ boards, 1000+ cards\n- Current architecture with optimizations\n- SQLite with WAL mode for better concurrent access\n- In-memory caching for frequently accessed data\n\n### Phase 2: Multi-User (Months 3-6)\n**Target**: 10-50 users, shared boards\n- Migrate from SQLite to PostgreSQL\n- Add Redis for session management and caching\n- Implement real-time updates with WebSockets\n- Add user permissions and board sharing\n\n### Phase 3: Small Team (Year 1)\n**Target**: 100-500 users, team workspaces\n- Horizontal scaling with load balancer\n- Database read replicas\n- CDN for static assets\n- Advanced caching strategies\n\n### Phase 4: Enterprise (Future)\n**Target**: 1000+ users, organizations\n- Microservices architecture\n- Message queue system (Redis/RabbitMQ)\n- Database sharding\n- Auto-scaling infrastructure\n\n## Performance Bottlenecks and Solutions\n\n### Identified Bottlenecks\n\n#### 1. Large Board Rendering\n**Problem**: Boards with 100+ cards cause UI lag\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Solution: Virtual scrolling and progressive loading\nconst useVirtualizedBoard = (boardId: string) =&gt; {\n  const [visibleRange, setVisibleRange] = useState({ start: 0, end: 20 });\n  \n  return useMemo(() =&gt; {\n    return cards.slice(visibleRange.start, visibleRange.end);\n  }, [cards, visibleRange]);\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 2. Real-time Drag and Drop\n**Problem**: Position updates cause database thrashing\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Solution: Debounced position updates\nconst useDebouncedPositionUpdate = () =&gt; {\n  const updatePosition = useMemo(\n    () =&gt; debounce(async (cardId, newPosition) =&gt; {\n      await updateCardPosition({ cardId, position: newPosition });\n    }, 500),\n    []\n  );\n  \n  return updatePosition;\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 3. Search Performance\n**Problem**: Text search across all cards is slow\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Solution: Full-text search indexes\nCREATE VIRTUAL TABLE cards_fts USING fts5(\n  title, description, content='cards', content_rowid='id'\n);\n\n-- Triggers to keep FTS table updated\nCREATE TRIGGER cards_fts_insert AFTER INSERT ON cards BEGIN\n  INSERT INTO cards_fts(rowid, title, description) \n  VALUES (new.id, new.title, new.description);\nEND;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Performance Monitoring\n\n#### Frontend Monitoring\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Performance tracking\nconst usePerformanceTracking = () =&gt; {\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // Track Core Web Vitals\n    getCLS(console.log);\n    getFID(console.log);\n    getFCP(console.log);\n    getLCP(console.log);\n    getTTFB(console.log);\n  }, []);\n};\n\n// Bundle size monitoring\nconst bundleAnalyzer = require('webpack-bundle-analyzer');\n// Run after build to analyze bundle composition\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Backend Monitoring\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Request timing middleware\nconst performanceMiddleware = (req, res, next) =&gt; {\n  const start = Date.now();\n  \n  res.on('finish', () =&gt; {\n    const duration = Date.now() - start;\n    logger.info('Request performance', {\n      method: req.method,\n      url: req.url,\n      duration,\n      statusCode: res.statusCode\n    });\n  });\n  \n  next();\n};\n\n// Database query performance\nconst prismaWithLogging = prisma.$extends({\n  query: {\n    $allModels: {\n      async $allOperations({ operation, model, args, query }) {\n        const start = Date.now();\n        const result = await query(args);\n        const end = Date.now();\n        \n        console.log(&#96;${model}.${operation} took ${end - start}ms&#96;);\n        return result;\n      },\n    },\n  },\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Caching Strategies\n\n### Multi-Layer Caching Architecture\n\n#### Layer 1: Browser Cache\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Service Worker for offline functionality\nself.addEventListener('fetch', (event) =&gt; {\n  if (event.request.url.includes('/api/')) {\n    event.respondWith(\n      caches.match(event.request).then((response) =&gt; {\n        return response || fetch(event.request);\n      })\n    );\n  }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Layer 2: Application Cache (Redux + RTK Query)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// RTK Query cache configuration\nexport const boardsApi = createApi({\n  reducerPath: 'boardsApi',\n  tagTypes: ['Board', 'List', 'Card'],\n  keepUnusedDataFor: 300, // 5 minutes\n  endpoints: (builder) =&gt; ({\n    getBoard: builder.query({\n      query: (id) =&gt; &#96;boards/${id}&#96;,\n      providesTags: (result, error, id) =&gt; [{ type: 'Board', id }],\n      // Cache for 10 minutes\n      keepUnusedDataFor: 600,\n    }),\n  }),\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Layer 3: Server-Side Cache (Redis - Future)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Redis caching layer\nclass CacheService {\n  async get&lt;T&gt;(key: string): Promise&lt;T | null&gt; {\n    const cached = await redis.get(key);\n    return cached ? JSON.parse(cached) : null;\n  }\n  \n  async set(key: string, value: any, ttl = 3600): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    await redis.setex(key, ttl, JSON.stringify(value));\n  }\n  \n  async invalidate(pattern: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    const keys = await redis.keys(pattern);\n    if (keys.length &gt; 0) {\n      await redis.del(...keys);\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// Usage in service layer\nclass BoardService {\n  async findById(id: string): Promise&lt;Board&gt; {\n    const cacheKey = &#96;board:${id}&#96;;\n    const cached = await this.cache.get&lt;Board&gt;(cacheKey);\n    \n    if (cached) return cached;\n    \n    const board = await this.repository.findById(id);\n    await this.cache.set(cacheKey, board, 1800); // 30 minutes\n    \n    return board;\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Layer 4: Database Query Cache\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Prisma query caching\nconst cachedPrisma = prisma.$extends({\n  query: {\n    board: {\n      findMany: async ({ args, query }) =&gt; {\n        const cacheKey = &#96;boards:${JSON.stringify(args)}&#96;;\n        \n        // Check cache first\n        const cached = await cache.get(cacheKey);\n        if (cached) return cached;\n        \n        // Execute query and cache result\n        const result = await query(args);\n        await cache.set(cacheKey, result, 300);\n        \n        return result;\n      },\n    },\n  },\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Load Balancing Considerations (Future)\n\n### Application Load Balancing\n&#96;&#96;&#96;yaml\n# docker-compose.yml for scaled deployment\nversion: '3.8'\nservices:\n  nginx:\n    image: nginx:alpine\n    ports:\n      - \"80:80\"\n      - \"443:443\"\n    depends_on:\n      - api-1\n      - api-2\n    volumes:\n      - ./nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf\n\n  api-1:\n    build: ./backend\n    environment:\n      - NODE_ENV=production\n      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:pass@db:5432/driftboard\n\n  api-2:\n    build: ./backend\n    environment:\n      - NODE_ENV=production\n      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:pass@db:5432/driftboard\n\n  db:\n    image: postgres:15\n    environment:\n      POSTGRES_DB: driftboard\n      POSTGRES_USER: user\n      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: pass\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Database Load Balancing\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Read/Write splitting for scaled databases\nclass DatabaseService {\n  constructor(\n    private writeDb: PrismaClient,\n    private readDb: PrismaClient\n  ) {}\n\n  // Write operations go to primary\n  async create(data: any) {\n    return this.writeDb.board.create({ data });\n  }\n\n  // Read operations can use replica\n  async findMany(args: any) {\n    return this.readDb.board.findMany(args);\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Session Management for Scale\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Redis-based session store\nclass SessionStore {\n  constructor(private redis: Redis) {}\n\n  async set(sessionId: string, data: SessionData): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    await this.redis.setex(\n      &#96;session:${sessionId}&#96;,\n      3600, // 1 hour\n      JSON.stringify(data)\n    );\n  }\n\n  async get(sessionId: string): Promise&lt;SessionData | null&gt; {\n    const data = await this.redis.get(&#96;session:${sessionId}&#96;);\n    return data ? JSON.parse(data) : null;\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Resource Optimization\n\n### Docker Optimization\n&#96;&#96;&#96;dockerfile\n# Multi-stage build for smaller images\nFROM node:18-alpine AS builder\nWORKDIR /app\nCOPY package*.json ./\nRUN npm ci --only=production\n\nFROM node:18-alpine AS runtime\nRUN addgroup -g 1001 -S nodejs\nRUN adduser -S nodejs -u 1001\nWORKDIR /app\nCOPY --from=builder --chown=nodejs:nodejs /app/node_modules ./node_modules\nCOPY --chown=nodejs:nodejs . .\nUSER nodejs\nEXPOSE 3000\nCMD [\"npm\", \"start\"]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Memory Management\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Graceful memory management\nprocess.on('SIGTERM', async () =&gt; {\n  console.log('SIGTERM received, shutting down gracefully');\n  \n  // Close database connections\n  await prisma.$disconnect();\n  \n  // Close Redis connections\n  await redis.quit();\n  \n  // Close HTTP server\n  server.close(() =&gt; {\n    console.log('Process terminated');\n    process.exit(0);\n  });\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n",

  "textEditContent": "# Security Architecture - DriftBoard\n\n## Security Overview\n\nWhile DriftBoard starts as a single-user local deployment, security best practices are implemented from the beginning to enable safe public deployment and multi-user functionality in the future.\n\n## Authentication and Authorization\n\n### Firebase Authentication Integration\n\n#### Frontend Authentication Flow\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Auth context provider\ninterface AuthContextType {\n  user: User | null;\n  loading: boolean;\n  signIn: (provider: 'google' | 'github') =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;;\n  signOut: () =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;;\n  getIdToken: () =&gt; Promise&lt;string&gt;;\n}\n\nconst AuthContext = createContext&lt;AuthContextType | null&gt;(null);\n\nexport const AuthProvider: React.FC&lt;{ children: React.ReactNode }&gt; = ({ children }) =&gt; {\n  const [user, setUser] = useState&lt;User | null&gt;(null);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const unsubscribe = onAuthStateChanged(auth, async (firebaseUser) =&gt; {\n      if (firebaseUser) {\n        // Get ID token for API calls\n        const token = await firebaseUser.getIdToken();\n        // Store user data\n        setUser({\n          id: firebaseUser.uid,\n          email: firebaseUser.email!,\n          name: firebaseUser.displayName,\n          token\n        });\n      } else {\n        setUser(null);\n      }\n      setLoading(false);\n    });\n\n    return unsubscribe;\n  }, []);\n\n  const signIn = async (provider: 'google' | 'github') =&gt; {\n    const authProvider = provider === 'google' \n      ? new GoogleAuthProvider() \n      : new GithubAuthProvider();\n    \n    await signInWithPopup(auth, authProvider);\n  };\n\n  const signOut = async () =&gt; {\n    await firebaseSignOut(auth);\n  };\n\n  const getIdToken = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!user) throw new Error('No authenticated user');\n    return await auth.currentUser!.getIdToken();\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;AuthContext.Provider value={{ user, loading, signIn, signOut, getIdToken }}&gt;\n      {children}\n    &lt;/AuthContext.Provider&gt;\n  );\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Backend Token Verification\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Firebase Admin SDK setup\nimport { initializeApp, cert } from 'firebase-admin/app';\nimport { getAuth } from 'firebase-admin/auth';\n\nconst firebaseAdmin = initializeApp({\n  credential: cert({\n    projectId: process.env.FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID,\n    clientEmail: process.env.FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL,\n    privateKey: process.env.FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY?.replace(/\\\\n/g, '\\n'),\n  }),\n});\n\nconst adminAuth = getAuth(firebaseAdmin);\n\n// Authentication middleware\nexport const authMiddleware = async (\n  req: Request, \n  res: Response, \n  next: NextFunction\n) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const authHeader = req.headers.authorization;\n    if (!authHeader?.startsWith('Bearer ')) {\n      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'No token provided' });\n    }\n\n    const token = authHeader.split(' ')[1];\n    const decodedToken = await adminAuth.verifyIdToken(token);\n    \n    // Attach user info to request\n    req.user = {\n      id: decodedToken.uid,\n      email: decodedToken.email!,\n      emailVerified: decodedToken.email_verified || false,\n    };\n\n    next();\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Token verification failed:', error);\n    return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Invalid token' });\n  }\n};\n\n// User creation/update on first login\nexport const ensureUserExists = async (\n  req: Request, \n  res: Response, \n  next: NextFunction\n) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { id, email } = req.user!;\n    \n    let user = await prisma.user.findUnique({\n      where: { firebaseId: id }\n    });\n\n    if (!user) {\n      user = await prisma.user.create({\n        data: {\n          firebaseId: id,\n          email,\n          name: req.user!.name || null,\n        }\n      });\n    }\n\n    req.user!.dbId = user.id;\n    next();\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('User creation failed:', error);\n    return res.status(500).json({ error: 'User setup failed' });\n  }\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Authorization Patterns\n\n#### Resource-Based Authorization\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Authorization middleware for board access\nexport const authorizeBoard = async (\n  req: Request, \n  res: Response, \n  next: NextFunction\n) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const boardId = req.params.boardId || req.body.boardId;\n    const userId = req.user!.dbId;\n\n    const board = await prisma.board.findFirst({\n      where: { \n        id: boardId, \n        userId: userId \n      }\n    });\n\n    if (!board) {\n      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Board not found' });\n    }\n\n    req.board = board;\n    next();\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Board authorization failed:', error);\n    return res.status(500).json({ error: 'Authorization failed' });\n  }\n};\n\n// Usage in routes\nrouter.get('/boards/:boardId', \n  authMiddleware, \n  ensureUserExists, \n  authorizeBoard, \n  getBoardController\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Future Multi-User Authorization\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Enum for permission levels\nenum Permission {\n  READ = 'read',\n  WRITE = 'write',\n  ADMIN = 'admin'\n}\n\n// Board sharing model (future)\nmodel BoardMember {\n  id         String     @id @default(uuid())\n  boardId    String\n  userId     String\n  permission Permission @default(READ)\n  invitedAt  DateTime   @default(now())\n  acceptedAt DateTime?\n  \n  board      Board      @relation(fields: [boardId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  user       User       @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  \n  @@unique([boardId, userId])\n  @@map(\"board_members\")\n}\n\n// Permission checking function\nconst hasPermission = async (\n  userId: string, \n  boardId: string, \n  requiredPermission: Permission\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; =&gt; {\n  const membership = await prisma.boardMember.findUnique({\n    where: { \n      boardId_userId: { boardId, userId } \n    }\n  });\n\n  if (!membership) return false;\n\n  const permissionHierarchy = [Permission.READ, Permission.WRITE, Permission.ADMIN];\n  const userLevel = permissionHierarchy.indexOf(membership.permission);\n  const requiredLevel = permissionHierarchy.indexOf(requiredPermission);\n\n  return userLevel &gt;= requiredLevel;\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Data Protection and Encryption\n\n### Database Security\n\n#### Data Encryption at Rest\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Sensitive data encryption using crypto\nimport crypto from 'crypto';\n\nconst ENCRYPTION_KEY = process.env.ENCRYPTION_KEY!; // 32 byte key\nconst ALGORITHM = 'aes-256-gcm';\n\nexport const encrypt = (text: string): string =&gt; {\n  const iv = crypto.randomBytes(16);\n  const cipher = crypto.createCipher(ALGORITHM, ENCRYPTION_KEY);\n  cipher.setAAD(Buffer.from('driftboard', 'utf8'));\n  \n  let encrypted = cipher.update(text, 'utf8', 'hex');\n  encrypted += cipher.final('hex');\n  \n  const authTag = cipher.getAuthTag();\n  \n  return &#96;${iv.toString('hex')}:${authTag.toString('hex')}:${encrypted}&#96;;\n};\n\nexport const decrypt = (encryptedText: string): string =&gt; {\n  const [ivHex, authTagHex, encrypted] = encryptedText.split(':');\n  \n  const iv = Buffer.from(ivHex, 'hex');\n  const authTag = Buffer.from(authTagHex, 'hex');\n  \n  const decipher = crypto.createDecipher(ALGORITHM, ENCRYPTION_KEY);\n  decipher.setAAD(Buffer.from('driftboard', 'utf8'));\n  decipher.setAuthTag(authTag);\n  \n  let decrypted = decipher.update(encrypted, 'hex', 'utf8');\n  decrypted += decipher.final('utf8');\n  \n  return decrypted;\n};\n\n// Prisma middleware for automatic encryption\nprisma.$use(async (params, next) =&gt; {\n  // Encrypt sensitive fields before saving\n  if (params.action === 'create' || params.action === 'update') {\n    if (params.model === 'Card' &amp;&amp; params.args.data.description) {\n      params.args.data.description = encrypt(params.args.data.description);\n    }\n  }\n  \n  const result = await next(params);\n  \n  // Decrypt sensitive fields after retrieving\n  if (params.action === 'findUnique' || params.action === 'findMany') {\n    if (params.model === 'Card' &amp;&amp; result) {\n      const cards = Array.isArray(result) ? result : [result];\n      cards.forEach(card =&gt; {\n        if (card.description) {\n          card.description = decrypt(card.description);\n        }\n      });\n    }\n  }\n  \n  return result;\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Database Connection Security\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Secure database configuration\nconst databaseUrl = new URL(process.env.DATABASE_URL!);\n\n// For production PostgreSQL\nconst prisma = new PrismaClient({\n  datasources: {\n    db: {\n      url: process.env.DATABASE_URL,\n    },\n  },\n  log: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' ? ['query'] : ['error'],\n});\n\n// Connection pool configuration\nconst prismaWithPool = new PrismaClient({\n  datasources: {\n    db: {\n      url: &#96;${process.env.DATABASE_URL}?connection_limit=10&amp;pool_timeout=20&amp;socket_timeout=60&#96;,\n    },\n  },\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Transport Security\n\n#### HTTPS Configuration\n&#96;&#96;&#96;nginx\n# nginx.conf for production deployment\nserver {\n    listen 80;\n    server_name driftboard.yourdomain.com;\n    \n    # Redirect HTTP to HTTPS\n    return 301 https://$server_name$request_uri;\n}\n\nserver {\n    listen 443 ssl http2;\n    server_name driftboard.yourdomain.com;\n    \n    # SSL Configuration\n    ssl_certificate /etc/ssl/certs/driftboard.crt;\n    ssl_certificate_key /etc/ssl/private/driftboard.key;\n    \n    # Modern SSL configuration\n    ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;\n    ssl_ciphers ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA512:DHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA512:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384;\n    ssl_prefer_server_ciphers off;\n    \n    # Security headers\n    add_header Strict-Transport-Security \"max-age=63072000\" always;\n    add_header X-Content-Type-Options nosniff;\n    add_header X-Frame-Options DENY;\n    add_header X-XSS-Protection \"1; node:18-alpine AS base\nRUN addgroup -g 1001 -S nodejs\nRUN adduser -S backend -u 1001\n\nFROM base AS deps\nWORKDIR /app\nCOPY backend/package*.json ./\nRUN npm ci --only=production &amp;&amp; npm --from=deps --chown=backend:nodejs /app/node_modules ./node_modules\nCOPY --from=builder --chown=backend:nodejs /app/dist ./dist\nCOPY --from=builder --chown=backend:nodejs /app/prisma ./prisma\nCOPY --chown=backend:nodejs backend/package*.json ./\n\nEXPOSE 8000\nHEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=5s --retries=3 \\\n  CMD curl -f http://localhost:8000/health || exit 1\n\nCMD [\"npm\", \"start\"]\n\nFROM base AS development\nWORKDIR /app\nUSER backend\nCOPY --chown=backend:nodejs backend/package*.json ./\nRUN npm install\nCOPY --chown=backend:nodejs backend/ .\nEXPOSE 8000\nCMD [\"npm\", \"run\", \"dev\"]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Deployment Script\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n#!/bin/bash\n# scripts/deploy.sh\n\nset -e\n\necho \"🚀 Deploying DriftBoard to production...\"\n\n# Environment validation\nif [ ! -f \".env.production\" ]; then\n    echo \"❌ .env.production file not found\"\n    exit 1\nfi\n\n# Backup current deployment\necho \"💾 Creating backup of current deployment...\"\ndocker-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec backup /bin/sh -c \"cp /data/production.db /backups/pre-deploy-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).db\"\n\n# Pull latest changes\necho \"📥 Pulling latest changes...\"\ngit pull origin main\n\n# Build new images\necho \"🔨 Building new images...\"\ndocker-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml build --no-cache\n\n# Run database migrations\necho \"🗄️  Running database migrations...\"\ndocker-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml run --rm backend npx prisma migrate deploy\n\n# Update services with zero downtime\necho \"♻️  Updating services...\"\ndocker-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --no-deps frontend\ndocker-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --no-deps backend\n\n# Health check\necho \"🏥 Performing health check...\"\nsleep 10\nif ! curl -f http://localhost/health; then\n    echo \"❌ Health check failed, rolling back...\"\n    docker-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml rollback\n    exit 1\nfi\n\n# Cleanup old images\necho \"🧹 Cleaning up old images...\"\ndocker image prune -f\n\necho \"✅ Deployment completed successfully!\"\necho \"🌐 Application available at: http://localhost\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Monitoring and Logging\n\n### Application Monitoring\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// backend/src/middleware/monitoring.ts\nimport prometheus from 'prom-client';\n\n// Create metrics registry\nconst register = new prometheus.Registry();\n\n// Default metrics\nprometheus.collectDefaultMetrics({ register });\n\n// Custom metrics\nconst httpRequestDuration = new prometheus.Histogram({\n  name: 'http_request_duration_seconds',\n  help: 'Duration of HTTP requests in seconds',\n  labelNames: ['method', 'route', 'status'],\n  buckets: [0.1, 0.5, 1, 2, 5],\n});\n\nconst httpRequestsTotal = new prometheus.Counter({\n  name: 'http_requests_total',\n  help: 'Total number of HTTP requests',\n  labelNames: ['method', 'route', 'status'],\n});\n\nconst databaseQueryDuration = new prometheus.Histogram({\n  name: 'database_query_duration_seconds',\n  help: 'Duration of database queries in seconds',\n  labelNames: ['operation', 'model'],\n});\n\nregister.registerMetric(httpRequestDuration);\nregister.registerMetric(httpRequestsTotal);\nregister.registerMetric(databaseQueryDuration);\n\nexport const metricsMiddleware = (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) =&gt; {\n  const start = Date.now();\n  \n  res.on('finish', () =&gt; {\n    const duration = (Date.now() - start) / 1000;\n    const route = req.route?.path || 'unknown';\n    \n    httpRequestDuration\n      .labels(req.method, route, res.statusCode.toString())\n      .observe(duration);\n    \n    httpRequestsTotal\n      .labels(req.method, route, res.statusCode.toString())\n      .inc();\n  });\n  \n  next();\n};\n\nexport const metricsEndpoint = async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  res.set('Content-Type', register.contentType);\n  res.end(await register.metrics());\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Structured Logging\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// backend/src/utils/logger.ts\nimport winston from 'winston';\n\nconst logFormat = winston.format.combine(\n  winston.format.timestamp(),\n  winston.format.errors({ stack: true }),\n  winston.format.json()\n);\n\nexport const logger = winston.createLogger({\n  level: process.env.LOG_LEVEL || 'info',\n  format: logFormat,\n  defaultMeta: { service: 'driftboard-api' },\n  transports: [\n    new winston.transports.File({ \n      filename: 'logs/error.log', \n      level: 'error' \n    }),\n    new winston.transports.File({ \n      filename: 'logs/combined.log' \n    }),\n  ],\n});\n\nif (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') {\n  logger.add(new winston.transports.Console({\n    format: winston.format.combine(\n      winston.format.colorize(),\n      winston.format.simple()\n    )\n  }));\n}\n\n// Request logging middleware\nexport const requestLogger = (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) =&gt; {\n  logger.info('HTTP Request', {\n    method: req.method,\n    url: req.url,\n    userAgent: req.get('User-Agent'),\n    ip: req.ip,\n    userId: req.user?.id,\n  });\n  next();\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Health Check Endpoints\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// backend/src/routes/health.ts\nexport const healthRouter = Router();\n\nhealthRouter.get('/health', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  const checks = {\n    server: 'ok',\n    database: 'checking',\n    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n  };\n\n  try {\n    // Check database connection\n    await prisma.$queryRaw&#96;SELECT 1&#96;;\n    checks.database = 'ok';\n  } catch (error) {\n    checks.database = 'error';\n    logger.error('Database health check failed', error);\n  }\n\n  const status = Object.values(checks).includes('error') ? 500 : 200;\n  res.status(status).json(checks);\n});\n\nhealthRouter.get('/metrics', metricsEndpoint);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Log Aggregation (Future)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;yaml\n# docker-compose.monitoring.yml\nversion: '3.8'\n\nservices:\n  # ... existing services ...\n\n  loki:\n    image: grafana/loki:latest\n    ports:\n      - \"3100:3100\"\n    volumes:\n      - ./monitoring/loki.yml:/etc/loki/local-config.yaml\n    command: -config.file=/etc/loki/local-config.yaml\n\n  promtail:\n    image: grafana/promtail:latest\n    volumes:\n      - logs:/var/log\n      - ./monitoring/promtail.yml:/etc/promtail/config.yml\n    command: -config.file=/etc/promtail/config.yml\n\n  grafana:\n    image: grafana/grafana:latest\n    ports:\n      - \"3001:3000\"\n    environment:\n      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin\n    volumes:\n      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana\n\nvolumes:\n  grafana_data:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n",

  "textEditContent": "# Alternative Approaches Analysis - DriftBoard\n\n## Overview\n\nThis document analyzes three different architectural approaches for DriftBoard, evaluating their trade-offs and providing a clear recommendation based on the project requirements and constraints.\n\n## Approach 1: Monolithic Full-Stack with SQLite (Recommended)\n\n### Architecture Description\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                     Single Docker Container                    │\n│                                                                 │\n│  ┌─────────────────┐  ┌─────────────────┐  ┌─────────────────┐ │\n│  │   React SPA     │  │   Express API   │  │     SQLite      │ │\n│  │   (Built)       │◄─┤   + TypeScript  │◄─┤   + File-based  │ │\n│  │   Static Files  │  │   + Prisma ORM  │  │   + WAL Mode    │ │\n│  │                 │  │                 │  │                 │ │\n│  │   Served by     │  │   Port: 8000    │  │   Volume Mount  │ │\n│  │   Express       │  │   + Static      │  │   /data/app.db  │ │\n│  └─────────────────┘  └─────────────────┘  └─────────────────┘ │\n│                                │                              │\n│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐  │\n│  │              Firebase Auth (External)                   │  │\n│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Technology Stack\n- **Frontend**: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Redux Toolkit\n- **Backend**: Node.js + Express + TypeScript + Prisma\n- **Database**: SQLite with WAL mode\n- **Authentication**: Firebase Auth\n- **Deployment**: Single Docker container\n- **Reverse Proxy**: Express serving static files\n\n### Implementation Details\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Single server setup\nconst app = express();\n\n// Serve static React files\napp.use(express.static(path.join(__dirname, '../frontend/dist')));\n\n// API routes\napp.use('/api', apiRouter);\n\n// Fallback to React app for client-side routing\napp.get('*', (req, res) =&gt; {\n  res.sendFile(path.join(__dirname, '../frontend/dist/index.html'));\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Pros\n- ✅ **Simplest deployment**: Single container, minimal configuration\n- ✅ **Fastest development setup**: No network configuration between services\n- ✅ **Resource efficient**: Single process, minimal overhead\n- ✅ **Perfect for single user**: No scaling complexity needed\n- ✅ **Easy backup**: Single SQLite file to backup\n- ✅ **Zero network latency**: In-memory communication\n- ✅ **Simplified debugging**: Single log stream, single process to debug\n\n### Cons\n- ❌ **Less scalable**: Harder to scale individual components\n- ❌ **Technology coupling**: Frontend and backend in same container\n- ❌ **Single point of failure**: Entire app goes down if container fails\n- ❌ **Build complexity**: Need to build both frontend and backend in one image\n\n### When to Choose\n- Single user deployment (current requirement)\n- Learning/experimental projects\n- Resource-constrained environments\n- Simplicity is more important than scalability\n\n## Approach 2: Microservices with Container Orchestration (Over-engineered)\n\n### Architecture Description\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                    Docker Compose Stack                        │\n│                                                                 │\n│  ┌─────────────┐  ┌─────────────┐  ┌─────────────┐  ┌─────────┐ │\n│  │   Nginx     │  │  Frontend   │  │   Backend   │  │  Redis  │ │\n│  │   Reverse   │◄─┤   React     │◄─┤   Express   │◄─┤  Cache  │ │\n│  │   Proxy     │  │   Container │  │   Container │  │         │ │\n│  │   SSL Term  │  │             │  │             │  │         │ │\n│  │             │  │  Port: 3000 │  │  Port: 8000 │  │  Port:  │ │\n│  │  Port: 80   │  │             │  │             │  │  6379   │ │\n│  └─────────────┘  └─────────────┘  └─────────────┘  └─────────┘ │\n│         │                                  │                    │\n│         │          ┌─────────────┐        │                    │\n│         │          │ PostgreSQL  │◄───────┘                    │\n│         │          │ Database    │                             │\n│         │          │ Container   │                             │\n│         │          │             │                             │\n│         │          │ Port: 5432  │                             │\n│         │          └─────────────┘                             │\n│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐  │\n│  │              External Services                          │  │\n│  │  Firebase Auth + Cloud Storage + Monitoring            │  │\n│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Technology Stack\n- **Frontend**: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite (Separate container)\n- **Backend**: Node.js + Express + TypeScript (Separate container)\n- **Database**: PostgreSQL (Separate container)\n- **Cache**: Redis (Separate container)\n- **Proxy**: Nginx (Separate container)\n- **Authentication**: Firebase Auth\n- **Monitoring**: Prometheus + Grafana containers\n\n### Implementation Details\n&#96;&#96;&#96;yaml\n# docker-compose.yml\nversion: '3.8'\nservices:\n  nginx:\n    image: nginx:alpine\n    ports: [\"80:80\", \"443:443\"]\n    depends_on: [frontend, backend]\n\n  frontend:\n    build: ./frontend\n    environment:\n      - NODE_ENV=production\n\n  backend:\n    build: ./backend\n    depends_on: [postgres, redis]\n    environment:\n      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:pass@postgres:5432/driftboard\n\n  postgres:\n    image: postgres:15\n    environment:\n      - POSTGRES_DB=driftboard\n    volumes: [postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data]\n\n  redis:\n    image: redis:alpine\n    volumes: [redis_data:/data]\n\n  prometheus:\n    image: prom/prometheus\n    ports: [\"9090:9090\"]\n\n  grafana:\n    image: grafana/grafana\n    ports: [\"3001:3000\"]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Pros\n- ✅ **Highly scalable**: Can scale each service independently\n- ✅ **Technology flexibility**: Different tech stacks per service\n- ✅ **Production-ready**: Industry standard architecture\n- ✅ **Resilient**: Failure isolation between services\n- ✅ **Development isolation**: Teams can work on services independently\n- ✅ **Performance**: Dedicated resources per service\n\n### Cons\n- ❌ **Over-complexity**: Far exceeds current requirements\n- ❌ **Resource intensive**: Multiple containers, high memory usage\n- ❌ **Network latency**: Inter-service communication overhead\n- ❌ **Operational complexity**: More services to monitor and debug\n- ❌ **Development overhead**: Complex local development setup\n- ❌ **Deployment complexity**: Orchestration, service discovery, etc.\n\n### When to Choose\n- Multi-team development\n- High traffic applications (10k+ users)\n- Need independent scaling of components\n- Enterprise environments with dedicated DevOps teams\n\n## Approach 3: Hybrid Multi-Container with Simplified Architecture (Middle Ground)\n\n### Architecture Description\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                    Docker Compose Stack                        │\n│                                                                 │\n│  ┌─────────────────┐  ┌─────────────────┐  ┌─────────────────┐ │\n│  │     Nginx       │  │    Frontend     │  │     Backend     │ │\n│  │   Reverse       │◄─┤     React       │◄─┤    Express      │ │\n│  │   Proxy         │  │    Container    │  │   Container     │ │\n│  │   + SSL         │  │    (Vite Dev    │  │   + Prisma      │ │\n│  │                 │  │     or Built)   │  │   + SQLite      │ │\n│  │  Port: 80/443   │  │   Port: 3000    │  │   Port: 8000    │ │\n│  └─────────────────┘  └─────────────────┘  └─────────────────┘ │\n│                                                    │            │\n│                           ┌─────────────────────────────────┐  │\n│                           │       Shared Volume             │  │\n│                           │     SQLite Database File       │  │\n│                           │    + Backup Directory          │  │\n│                           └─────────────────────────────────┘  │\n│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐  │\n│  │              Firebase Auth (External)                   │  │\n│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Technology Stack\n- **Frontend**: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite (Separate container)\n- **Backend**: Node.js + Express + TypeScript + Prisma (Separate container)\n- **Database**: SQLite with shared volume\n- **Proxy**: Nginx for routing and SSL\n- **Authentication**: Firebase Auth\n\n### Implementation Details\n&#96;&#96;&#96;yaml\n# docker-compose.yml\nversion: '3.8'\nservices:\n  nginx:\n    image: nginx:alpine\n    ports:\n      - \"80:80\"\n      - \"443:443\"\n    volumes:\n      - ./nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf\n    depends_on:\n      - frontend\n      - backend\n\n  frontend:\n    build:\n      context: ./frontend\n      target: production\n    environment:\n      - NODE_ENV=production\n      - VITE_API_URL=/api\n\n  backend:\n    build: ./backend\n    environment:\n      - NODE_ENV=production\n      - DATABASE_URL=file:/data/app.db\n    volumes:\n      - app_data:/data\n    healthcheck:\n      test: [\"CMD\", \"curl\", \"-f\", \"http://localhost:8000/health\"]\n\n  backup:\n    image: alpine:latest\n    volumes:\n      - app_data:/data:ro\n      - ./backups:/backups\n    command: |\n      sh -c \"while true; do \n        cp /data/app.db /backups/backup-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).db\n        find /backups -name '*.db' -mtime +7 -delete\n        sleep 86400\n      done\"\n\nvolumes:\n  app_data:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Pros\n- ✅ **Balanced complexity**: More scalable than monolith, simpler than microservices\n- ✅ **Development separation**: Can develop frontend/backend independently\n- ✅ **Production-ready**: Nginx for SSL, proper separation of concerns\n- ✅ **Easy to understand**: Clear service boundaries\n- ✅ **Container benefits**: Isolation, easy deployment, consistent environments\n- ✅ **Flexible scaling**: Can scale frontend/backend separately if needed\n- ✅ **Modern architecture**: Industry standard patterns without over-engineering\n\n### Cons\n- ❌ **More complex than needed**: For single user, might be overkill\n- ❌ **Network overhead**: HTTP calls between containers\n- ❌ **More moving parts**: Multiple containers to manage\n- ❌ **Development setup**: Slightly more complex than monolith\n\n### When to Choose\n- Planning to scale to multiple users soon\n- Want to learn modern containerization practices\n- Need flexibility for future growth\n- Prefer separation of concerns\n\n## Recommendation and Reasoning\n\n### Primary Recommendation: Approach 1 (Monolithic Full-Stack)\n\n**Given the current requirements and constraints, Approach 1 is the clear winner.**\n\n#### Alignment with Requirements\n1. **Single User Target**: Perfect fit for current needs\n2. **$0 Budget**: Minimal resource usage\n3. **Learning Experience**: Focuses on React/TypeScript/Firebase learning rather than DevOps complexity\n4. **AI-Assisted Development**: Simpler architecture easier for AI to help with\n\n#### Technical Justification\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Simple deployment command\ndocker run -p 80:8000 -v ./data:/app/data driftboard:latest\n\n// vs complex orchestration\ndocker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Risk Mitigation\n- **Scalability Concern**: Can refactor to Approach 3 when multi-user needed\n- **Technology Coupling**: Acceptable for learning project scope\n- **Single Point of Failure**: Acceptable for personal use with good backup strategy\n\n### Secondary Recommendation: Approach 3 (When to Upgrade)\n\n**Consider upgrading to Approach 3 when:**\n- Planning to support 5+ users\n- Need independent scaling of frontend/backend\n- Want to practice production-ready patterns\n- Ready to invest in operational complexity\n\n### Why Not Approach 2\n\nApproach 2 is over-engineered for this project:\n- **PostgreSQL**: Unnecessary complexity vs SQLite for &lt;100 users\n- **Redis**: No caching needs with current user count\n- **Monitoring Stack**: Premature optimization\n- **Service Mesh**: Zero benefit for 3 services\n\n## Migration Path\n\n### Phase 1 → Phase 2 Migration\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Extract frontend to separate container\nmkdir frontend-container\nmv build/ frontend-container/\ncreate frontend.Dockerfile\n\n# Update backend to API-only\nremove static file serving\nupdate CORS configuration\n\n# Add nginx reverse proxy\ncreate nginx configuration\nupdate docker-compose.yml\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Phase 2 → Phase 3 Migration (If Ever Needed)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Database migration\nsqlite_to_postgres_migration.sql\nupdate DATABASE_URL\n\n# Add Redis\nadd redis container\nimplement caching layer\n\n# Add monitoring\nadd prometheus/grafana containers\nimplement metrics collection\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Decision Matrix\n\n| Criteria | Approach 1 | Approach 2 | Approach 3 |\n|----------|------------|------------|------------|\n| **Development Speed** | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ | ⭐⭐ | ⭐⭐⭐ |\n| **Resource Usage** | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ | ⭐⭐ | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ |\n| **Scalability** | ⭐⭐ | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ |\n| **Learning Value** | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ | ⭐⭐⭐ | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ |\n| **Operational Complexity** | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ | ⭐ | ⭐⭐⭐ |\n| **Production Readiness** | ⭐⭐⭐ | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ |\n| **Fits Current Needs** | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ | ⭐ | ⭐⭐⭐ |\n| **Future Flexibility** | ⭐⭐ | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ |\n\n## Conclusion\n\nStart with **Approach 1** for MVP and initial learning. The monolithic approach perfectly matches the current requirements while providing a solid foundation for learning React, TypeScript, and Firebase.\n\nWhen the project grows beyond personal use (3+ users or need for independent scaling), migrate to **Approach 3** for a production-ready architecture without unnecessary complexity.\n\n**Approach 2** should only be considered for enterprise-scale applications with dedicated DevOps teams and complex scaling requirements - which is unlikely to ever be needed for this project.\n",

  "textEditContent": "# Implementation Phases - DriftBoard\n\n## Overview\n\nThis document outlines a phased approach to implementing DriftBoard, breaking down the architecture into manageable development phases while maintaining clear dependencies and MVP considerations.\n\n## Phase 1: MVP Foundation (Week 1-2)\n\n### Objectives\n- Basic kanban functionality working end-to-end\n- User authentication implemented\n- Docker containerization complete\n- Core CRUD operations functional\n\n### User Stories\n- ✅ As a user, I can sign in with Google/GitHub via Firebase Auth\n- ✅ As a user, I can create, view, edit, and delete boards\n- ✅ As a user, I can create, view, edit, and delete lists within boards\n- ✅ As a user, I can create, view, edit, and delete cards within lists\n- ✅ As a user, I can drag and drop cards between lists\n- ✅ As a user, I can access the app via Docker container\n\n### Technical Implementation\n\n#### Project Setup\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Day 1: Project scaffolding\nmkdir driftboard &amp;&amp; cd driftboard\nmkdir frontend backend docker docs\n\n# Frontend setup\ncd frontend\nnpm create vite@latest . -- --template react-ts\nnpm install @reduxjs/toolkit react-redux @dnd-kit/core @dnd-kit/sortable\nnpm install firebase axios react-router-dom\nnpm install -D tailwindcss @shadcn/ui\n\n# Backend setup\ncd ../backend\nnpm init -y\nnpm install express prisma @prisma/client\nnpm install firebase-admin cors helmet express-rate-limit\nnpm install -D typescript @types/express @types/node tsx nodemon\n\n# Initialize Prisma\nnpx prisma init --datasource-provider sqlite\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Database Schema (Initial)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;prisma\n// prisma/schema.prisma\ngenerator client {\n  provider = \"prisma-client-js\"\n}\n\ndatasource db {\n  provider = \"sqlite\"\n  url      = env(\"DATABASE_URL\")\n}\n\nmodel User {\n  id         String   @id @default(uuid())\n  firebaseId String   @unique\n  email      String   @unique\n  name       String?\n  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())\n  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt\n\n  boards Board[]\n\n  @@map(\"users\")\n}\n\nmodel Board {\n  id          String   @id @default(uuid())\n  name        String\n  description String?\n  color       String?\n  position    Int      @default(0)\n  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())\n  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt\n\n  userId String\n  user   User   @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  lists  List[]\n\n  @@map(\"boards\")\n}\n\nmodel List {\n  id        String   @id @default(uuid())\n  name      String\n  position  Int      @default(0)\n  createdAt DateTime @default(now())\n  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt\n\n  boardId String\n  board   Board  @relation(fields: [boardId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  cards   Card[]\n\n  @@map(\"lists\")\n}\n\nmodel Card {\n  id          String   @id @default(uuid())\n  title       String\n  description String?\n  position    Int      @default(0)\n  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())\n  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt\n\n  listId String\n  list   List   @relation(fields: [listId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@map(\"cards\")\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Frontend Core Components\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// src/store/store.ts\nimport { configureStore } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';\nimport { boardsApi } from './api/boardsApi';\nimport authSlice from './slices/authSlice';\nimport uiSlice from './slices/uiSlice';\n\nexport const store = configureStore({\n  reducer: {\n    auth: authSlice,\n    ui: uiSlice,\n    [boardsApi.reducerPath]: boardsApi.reducer,\n  },\n  middleware: (getDefaultMiddleware) =&gt;\n    getDefaultMiddleware().concat(boardsApi.middleware),\n});\n\n// src/components/Board/BoardView.tsx\nexport const BoardView: React.FC&lt;{ boardId: string }&gt; = ({ boardId }) =&gt; {\n  const { data: board, isLoading } = useGetBoardQuery(boardId);\n  \n  if (isLoading) return &lt;div&gt;Loading...&lt;/div&gt;;\n  if (!board) return &lt;div&gt;Board not found&lt;/div&gt;;\n\n  return (\n    &lt;DndContext onDragEnd={handleDragEnd}&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"flex gap-4 p-4 overflow-x-auto\"&gt;\n        {board.lists.map((list) =&gt; (\n          &lt;ListComponent key={list.id} list={list} /&gt;\n        ))}\n        &lt;AddListButton boardId={boardId} /&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/DndContext&gt;\n  );\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Backend API Structure\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// src/routes/boards.ts\nexport const boardsRouter = Router();\n\nboardsRouter.get('/', authMiddleware, async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  const boards = await prisma.board.findMany({\n    where: { userId: req.user!.dbId },\n    include: {\n      lists: {\n        include: { cards: true },\n        orderBy: { position: 'asc' },\n      },\n    },\n    orderBy: { position: 'asc' },\n  });\n  res.json(boards);\n});\n\nboardsRouter.post('/', authMiddleware, validateRequest(CreateBoardSchema), async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  const board = await prisma.board.create({\n    data: {\n      ...req.body,\n      userId: req.user!.dbId,\n    },\n  });\n  res.status(201).json(board);\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Docker Configuration\n&#96;&#96;&#96;dockerfile\n# Dockerfile (Monolithic approach)\nFROM node:18-alpine AS frontend-builder\nWORKDIR /app/frontend\nCOPY frontend/package*.json ./\nRUN npm ci\nCOPY frontend/ .\nRUN npm run build\n\nFROM node:18-alpine AS backend-builder\nWORKDIR /app/backend\nCOPY backend/package*.json ./\nRUN npm ci\nCOPY backend/ .\nRUN npm run build\n\nFROM node:18-alpine AS runtime\nRUN addgroup -g 1001 -S nodejs &amp;&amp; adduser -S driftboard -u 1001\nWORKDIR /app\n\n# Copy backend\nCOPY --from=backend-builder --chown=driftboard:nodejs /app/backend/dist ./dist\nCOPY --from=backend-builder --chown=driftboard:nodejs /app/backend/node_modules ./node_modules\nCOPY --from=backend-builder --chown=driftboard:nodejs /app/backend/prisma ./prisma\n\n# Copy frontend build\nCOPY --from=frontend-builder --chown=driftboard:nodejs /app/frontend/dist ./public\n\nUSER driftboard\nEXPOSE 8000\nCMD [\"node\", \"dist/index.js\"]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Success Criteria\n- [ ] User can sign in and see their dashboard\n- [ ] User can create a board and see it in the list\n- [ ] User can create lists and cards\n- [ ] Drag and drop works between lists\n- [ ] App runs in Docker container\n- [ ] Data persists between container restarts\n\n### Dependencies Complete\n- Firebase project setup and configuration\n- Basic CI/CD pipeline (optional but recommended)\n- Domain name setup for Firebase auth (localhost OK for MVP)\n\n## Phase 2: Enhanced Functionality (Week 3-4)\n\n### Objectives\n- Rich card editing capabilities\n- Activity tracking and history\n- Search and filtering\n- Improved UI/UX with ShadCN components\n\n### User Stories\n- ✅ As a user, I can add descriptions to cards with Markdown support\n- ✅ As a user, I can set due dates on cards\n- ✅ As a user, I can add labels to cards for categorization\n- ✅ As a user, I can see activity history on cards\n- ✅ As a user, I can search across all boards and cards\n- ✅ As a user, I can archive boards and cards\n\n### Technical Implementation\n\n#### Enhanced Database Schema\n&#96;&#96;&#96;prisma\n// Add to existing schema.prisma\nmodel Card {\n  id          String    @id @default(uuid())\n  title       String\n  description String?\n  position    Int       @default(0)\n  dueDate     DateTime?\n  archived    Boolean   @default(false)\n  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())\n  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt\n\n  listId String\n  list   List   @relation(fields: [listId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  labels     Label[]\n  comments   Comment[]\n  activities Activity[]\n\n  @@map(\"cards\")\n}\n\nmodel Label {\n  id    String @id @default(uuid())\n  name  String\n  color String\n\n  cardId String\n  card   Card   @relation(fields: [cardId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@map(\"labels\")\n}\n\nmodel Comment {\n  id        String   @id @default(uuid())\n  content   String\n  createdAt DateTime @default(now())\n\n  cardId String\n  card   Card   @relation(fields: [cardId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@map(\"comments\")\n}\n\nmodel Activity {\n  id        String   @id @default(uuid())\n  type      String   // 'created', 'moved', 'updated', 'commented'\n  data      String   // JSON data about the activity\n  createdAt DateTime @default(now())\n\n  cardId String\n  card   Card   @relation(fields: [cardId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@map(\"activities\")\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Rich Card Editor\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// src/components/Card/CardEditModal.tsx\nexport const CardEditModal: React.FC&lt;{ cardId: string; isOpen: boolean }&gt; = ({\n  cardId,\n  isOpen,\n}) =&gt; {\n  const { data: card } = useGetCardQuery(cardId);\n  const [updateCard] = useUpdateCardMutation();\n\n  return (\n    &lt;Dialog open={isOpen}&gt;\n      &lt;DialogContent className=\"max-w-4xl\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"grid grid-cols-3 gap-6\"&gt;\n          &lt;div className=\"col-span-2\"&gt;\n            &lt;CardTitleEditor card={card} onUpdate={updateCard} /&gt;\n            &lt;MarkdownEditor\n              content={card?.description || ''}\n              onChange={(description) =&gt; updateCard({ id: cardId, description })}\n            /&gt;\n            &lt;CommentsList cardId={cardId} /&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n          &lt;div className=\"space-y-4\"&gt;\n            &lt;DueDatePicker card={card} onUpdate={updateCard} /&gt;\n            &lt;LabelsEditor card={card} onUpdate={updateCard} /&gt;\n            &lt;ActivityHistory cardId={cardId} /&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/DialogContent&gt;\n    &lt;/Dialog&gt;\n  );\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Search Implementation\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Backend: Full-text search\nexport const searchRouter = Router();\n\nsearchRouter.get('/cards', authMiddleware, async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  const { q } = req.query;\n  \n  const cards = await prisma.card.findMany({\n    where: {\n      list: {\n        board: {\n          userId: req.user!.dbId,\n        },\n      },\n      OR: [\n        { title: { contains: q as string, mode: 'insensitive' } },\n        { description: { contains: q as string, mode: 'insensitive' } },\n      ],\n    },\n    include: {\n      list: {\n        include: { board: true },\n      },\n      labels: true,\n    },\n  });\n\n  res.json(cards);\n});\n\n// Frontend: Search component\nexport const SearchBar: React.FC = () =&gt; {\n  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');\n  const { data: results } = useSearchCardsQuery(query, { skip: query.length &lt; 2 });\n\n  return (\n    &lt;Command className=\"rounded-lg border shadow-md\"&gt;\n      &lt;CommandInput\n        placeholder=\"Search cards...\"\n        value={query}\n        onValueChange={setQuery}\n      /&gt;\n      &lt;CommandList&gt;\n        {results?.map((card) =&gt; (\n          &lt;CommandItem key={card.id} onSelect={() =&gt; openCard(card.id)}&gt;\n            {card.title} - {card.list.board.name}\n          &lt;/CommandItem&gt;\n        ))}\n      &lt;/CommandList&gt;\n    &lt;/Command&gt;\n  );\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Success Criteria\n- [ ] Rich card editing modal with markdown support\n- [ ] Due dates can be set and are visually indicated\n- [ ] Labels can be created and applied to cards\n- [ ] Activity history shows card changes\n- [ ] Search finds cards across all boards\n- [ ] UI uses ShadCN components consistently\n\n## Phase 3: Production Polish (Week 5-6)\n\n### Objectives\n- Comprehensive testing suite\n- Performance optimizations\n- Error handling and user feedback\n- Data import/export capabilities\n\n### Technical Implementation\n\n#### Testing Suite\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Frontend: Component testing\n// src/components/Card/__tests__/Card.test.tsx\nimport { render, screen, fireEvent } from '@testing-library/react';\nimport { Provider } from 'react-redux';\nimport { Card } from '../Card';\n\ndescribe('Card Component', () =&gt; {\n  it('renders card title and description', () =&gt; {\n    const mockCard = {\n      id: '1',\n      title: 'Test Card',\n      description: 'Test Description',\n    };\n\n    render(\n      &lt;Provider store={mockStore}&gt;\n        &lt;Card card={mockCard} /&gt;\n      &lt;/Provider&gt;\n    );\n\n    expect(screen.getByText('Test Card')).toBeInTheDocument();\n    expect(screen.getByText('Test Description')).toBeInTheDocument();\n  });\n\n  it('handles drag and drop', async () =&gt; {\n    // Test drag and drop functionality\n  });\n});\n\n// Backend: API testing\n// src/routes/__tests__/boards.test.ts\ndescribe('Boards API', () =&gt; {\n  it('creates a new board', async () =&gt; {\n    const response = await request(app)\n      .post('/api/boards')\n      .set('Authorization', &#96;Bearer ${validToken}&#96;)\n      .send({\n        name: 'Test Board',\n        description: 'Test Description',\n      });\n\n    expect(response.status).toBe(201);\n    expect(response.body.name).toBe('Test Board');\n  });\n});\n\n// E2E Testing with Playwright\n// tests/board-management.spec.ts\ntest('complete board workflow', async ({ page }) =&gt; {\n  await page.goto('/');\n  await page.click('[data-testid=\"create-board\"]');\n  await page.fill('[data-testid=\"board-name\"]', 'Test Board');\n  await page.click('[data-testid=\"save-board\"]');\n  \n  // Verify board was created\n  await expect(page.locator('text=Test Board')).toBeVisible();\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Performance Optimizations\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Virtual scrolling for large lists\nimport { FixedSizeList as List } from 'react-window';\n\nexport const VirtualizedCardList: React.FC&lt;{ cards: Card[] }&gt; = ({ cards }) =&gt; {\n  const Row = ({ index, style }: { index: number; style: React.CSSProperties }) =&gt; (\n    &lt;div style={style}&gt;\n      &lt;Card card={cards[index]} /&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n\n  return (\n    &lt;List\n      height={600}\n      itemCount={cards.length}\n      itemSize={80}\n    &gt;\n      {Row}\n    &lt;/List&gt;\n  );\n};\n\n// Optimistic updates\nexport const useOptimisticCardUpdate = () =&gt; {\n  const [updateCard] = useUpdateCardMutation();\n  \n  return useCallback(async (cardId: string, updates: Partial&lt;Card&gt;) =&gt; {\n    // Optimistically update UI\n    dispatch(cardUpdated({ id: cardId, changes: updates }));\n    \n    try {\n      await updateCard({ id: cardId, ...updates }).unwrap();\n    } catch (error) {\n      // Revert optimistic update\n      dispatch(cardUpdateReverted(cardId));\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }, [updateCard, dispatch]);\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Error Handling\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Global error boundary\nexport class ErrorBoundary extends React.Component {\n  constructor(props: any) {\n    super(props);\n    this.state = { hasError: false };\n  }\n\n  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error) {\n    return { hasError: true };\n  }\n\n  componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: React.ErrorInfo) {\n    logger.error('React Error Boundary caught an error', error, errorInfo);\n  }\n\n  render() {\n    if (this.state.hasError) {\n      return &lt;ErrorFallback /&gt;;\n    }\n\n    return this.props.children;\n  }\n}\n\n// API error handling\nexport const errorHandler = (error: any, req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) =&gt; {\n  logger.error('API Error', error);\n\n  if (error instanceof ValidationError) {\n    return res.status(400).json({\n      error: 'Validation failed',\n      details: error.details,\n    });\n  }\n\n  if (error instanceof NotFoundError) {\n    return res.status(404).json({\n      error: 'Resource not found',\n    });\n  }\n\n  res.status(500).json({\n    error: 'Internal server error',\n    ...(process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' &amp;&amp; { details: error.message }),\n  });\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Success Criteria\n- [ ] 80%+ test coverage on core functionality\n- [ ] App handles network errors gracefully\n- [ ] Performance remains smooth with 100+ cards\n- [ ] Users can export their data as JSON\n- [ ] Error boundaries prevent app crashes\n\n## Phase 4: Future Enhancements (Month 2+)\n\n### Objectives\n- Multi-user support preparation\n- Advanced features implementation\n- Performance monitoring\n- Chrome extension foundation\n\n### Technical Implementation\n\n#### Multi-User Database Schema\n&#96;&#96;&#96;prisma\nmodel Board {\n  id          String   @id @default(uuid())\n  name        String\n  description String?\n  visibility  Visibility @default(PRIVATE) // PUBLIC, PRIVATE, TEAM\n  \n  ownerId     String\n  owner       User     @relation(\"OwnedBoards\", fields: [ownerId], references: [id])\n  members     BoardMember[]\n  \n  // ... existing fields\n}\n\nmodel BoardMember {\n  id         String     @id @default(uuid())\n  role       BoardRole  @default(VIEWER) // VIEWER, EDITOR, ADMIN\n  invitedAt  DateTime   @default(now())\n  acceptedAt DateTime?\n\n  boardId    String\n  board      Board      @relation(fields: [boardId], references: [id])\n  userId     String\n  user       User       @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])\n\n  @@unique([boardId, userId])\n  @@map(\"board_members\")\n}\n\nenum Visibility {\n  PUBLIC\n  PRIVATE\n  TEAM\n}\n\nenum BoardRole {\n  VIEWER\n  EDITOR\n  ADMIN\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Real-time Updates\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// WebSocket implementation\nimport { Server } from 'socket.io';\n\nexport const setupWebSocket = (server: any) =&gt; {\n  const io = new Server(server, {\n    cors: {\n      origin: process.env.FRONTEND_URL,\n      credentials: true,\n    },\n  });\n\n  io.use(async (socket, next) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const token = socket.handshake.auth.token;\n      const user = await verifyFirebaseToken(token);\n      socket.userId = user.uid;\n      next();\n    } catch (error) {\n      next(new Error('Authentication failed'));\n    }\n  });\n\n  io.on('connection', (socket) =&gt; {\n    socket.on('join-board', (boardId) =&gt; {\n      socket.join(&#96;board:${boardId}&#96;);\n    });\n\n    socket.on('card-updated', (data) =&gt; {\n      socket.to(&#96;board:${data.boardId}&#96;).emit('card-updated', data);\n    });\n  });\n};\n\n// Frontend WebSocket hook\nexport const useWebSocket = (boardId: string) =&gt; {\n  const socket = useRef&lt;Socket&gt;();\n  \n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    socket.current = io(process.env.VITE_WS_URL, {\n      auth: { token: await getAuthToken() },\n    });\n\n    socket.current.emit('join-board', boardId);\n    \n    socket.current.on('card-updated', (data) =&gt; {\n      dispatch(cardUpdated(data));\n    });\n\n    return () =&gt; socket.current?.disconnect();\n  }, [boardId]);\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Chrome Extension Foundation\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// manifest.json\n{\n  \"manifest_version\": 3,\n  \"name\": \"DriftBoard\",\n  \"version\": \"1.0\",\n  \"permissions\": [\"activeTab\", \"storage\"],\n  \"action\": {\n    \"default_popup\": \"popup.html\"\n  },\n  \"content_scripts\": [{\n    \"matches\": [\"&lt;all_urls&gt;\"],\n    \"js\": [\"content.js\"]\n  }]\n}\n\n// popup.tsx\nexport const Popup: React.FC = () =&gt; {\n  const [boards, setBoards] = useState&lt;Board[]&gt;([]);\n  \n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // Load user's boards\n    api.get('/boards').then(setBoards);\n  }, []);\n\n  const saveCurrentPage = async (boardId: string, listId: string) =&gt; {\n    const [tab] = await chrome.tabs.query({ active: true, currentWindow: true });\n    \n    await api.post('/cards', {\n      title: tab.title,\n      description: &#96;[${tab.title}](${tab.url})&#96;,\n      listId,\n    });\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"w-80 p-4\"&gt;\n      &lt;h2&gt;Save to DriftBoard&lt;/h2&gt;\n      {boards.map(board =&gt; (\n        &lt;BoardSelector \n          key={board.id} \n          board={board} \n          onSave={saveCurrentPage} \n        /&gt;\n      ))}\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Success Criteria\n- [ ] Database schema supports multi-user features\n- [ ] Real-time updates work across multiple browser sessions\n- [ ] Chrome extension can save pages to boards\n- [ ] Performance monitoring dashboard shows key metrics\n\n## Dependencies and Critical Path\n\n### Critical Path Analysis\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nProject Setup (1 day)\n    ↓\nFirebase Configuration (1 day)\n    ↓\nDatabase Schema (1 day)\n    ↓\nAuthentication (2 days)\n    ↓\nBasic CRUD API (3 days)\n    ↓\nFrontend Components (3 days)\n    ↓ \nDrag &amp; Drop (2 days)\n    ↓\nDocker Setup (1 day)\n    ↓\nIntegration Testing (1 day)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Parallel Development Tracks\n\n#### Track 1: Backend API\n- Day 1-2: Project setup + Firebase\n- Day 3-4: Database schema + basic CRUD\n- Day 5-7: Authentication + authorization\n- Day 8-9: Advanced features (search, activities)\n\n#### Track 2: Frontend Components\n- Day 1-2: React setup + routing\n- Day 3-4: Authentication flow\n- Day 5-7: Board/List/Card components\n- Day 8-9: Drag &amp; drop + UI polish\n\n#### Track 3: DevOps &amp; Testing\n- Day 7-8: Docker setup\n- Day 9-10: Testing suite\n- Day 11-12: Deployment automation\n\n### Risk Mitigation\n\n#### Technical Risks\n1. **Drag &amp; Drop Complexity**\n   - Mitigation: Use proven library (@dnd-kit)\n   - Fallback: Manual move buttons\n\n2. **Firebase Integration Issues**\n   - Mitigation: Start with simple email/password auth\n   - Fallback: JWT-only authentication\n\n3. **Docker Configuration Problems**\n   - Mitigation: Test locally before deployment\n   - Fallback: Direct Node.js deployment\n\n#### Scope Risks\n1. **Feature Creep**\n   - Mitigation: Strict MVP definition\n   - Process: Feature freeze after Phase 1 complete\n\n2. **Over-Engineering**\n   - Mitigation: Regular architecture reviews\n   - Principle: Choose simplest solution that works\n\n## Success Metrics\n\n### Phase 1 Metrics\n- ✅ User can complete full workflow (create board → list → card → move card) in &lt;2 minutes\n- ✅ App loads in &lt;3 seconds on initial visit\n- ✅ Zero authentication errors in testing\n- ✅ 100% core API endpoints working\n\n### Phase 2 Metrics\n- ✅ Search returns results in &lt;500ms\n- ✅ Card editing modal loads in &lt;1 second\n- ✅ All UI components use consistent design system\n- ✅ Activity history captures 100% of user actions\n\n### Phase 3 Metrics\n- ✅ &gt;80% test coverage\n- ✅ Zero unhandled exceptions in production logs\n- ✅ App remains responsive with 100+ cards per board\n- ✅ Data export/import functions correctly\n\n### Phase 4 Metrics\n- ✅ Real-time updates propagate in &lt;1 second\n- ✅ Chrome extension saves pages successfully\n- ✅ Multi-user permissions work correctly\n- ✅ Performance metrics dashboard functional\n\nThis phased approach ensures steady progress while maintaining flexibility to adjust based on learning and changing requirements. Each phase builds upon the previous while delivering incremental value to the user.\n",

  "textEditContent": "# Architecture Documentation Index\n\nThis directory contains comprehensive architecture documentation for DriftBoard, a personal kanban board application. - **SQLite**: Zero-config database perfect for single-user local deployment
- **Prisma**: Type-safe database access, excellent TypeScript integration
- **ShadCN/UI + Tailwind**: Modern, accessible components

### Migration Path
The architecture is designed to evolve:
1. **Phase 1**: Monolithic container (MVP)
2. **Phase 2**: Multi-container when multi-user needed
3. **Phase 3**: Microservices if enterprise scale required

- **Week 3-4**: Enhanced features (rich editing, search, labels)
